results.title: HOST.mp4
results.overview: After an encounter with a still life, Tristan treks deeper and deeper into relics of his internet-fueled childhood.

results.title: Something Like a Foolish Fire I Guess
Land of Fire
results.overview: In remote British Columbia, wildfires have become part of everyday life. The communities the film follows carry deep losses, visible in the burned forests and in the roadside posters of missing loved ones, many of them young women. Yet life here is shaped as much by resilience and solidarity as it is by grief.  Nikola Klinger has made a film about people facing complex challenges who nonetheless believe in a better future. By weaving together the interconnected lives of the locals, the film creates a layered portrait of the landscape and the people’s bond with the wilderness, its magic and its myths. Residents live in the shadow of unsolved deaths and the disappearances of young people, finding an escape from their troubles in community solidarity and modern-day rituals, such as the demolition derby at the local wreck yard.  “There is something alive out there in the bush; you can feel it, but you can’t see it.”

results.title: I See No Death
results.overview: The film follows a newly formed Ukrainian unmanned systems unit from its first deployment in the Donetsk region and on to operations on Russian territory. The daily lives of these modern-day warriors unfold in cold cellars and trenches, where destruction becomes a technical task and death is reduced to a few pixels on a monitor.

results.title: Love and DDR at Blacktown Mall
results.original_title: Love and DDR at Blacktown Mall
results.overview: On the verge of breaking up with her chaser boyfriend, Willow has a chance encounter with another doll that could change her life over a game of DDR.

results.title: Burning Roots, Blooming Fire
results.overview: In a changing village steeped in old lore, a young girl steps into a forbidden grove and uncovers a long-silenced red bloom; she awakens memories buried by power and time. Her quiet act stirs forgotten histories and resistance, blending folklore and reality to reflect on loss, memory and survival.

results.title: Allo Neredallo
results.overview: In rural Telangana, close friends Ganga and Suresh face separation when Ganga prepares to leave for the city. During a playful moment, Suresh accidentally hurts her, misinterpreting her first menstrual cycle as an injury. As traditional rituals isolate Ganga for marriage, their friendship is tested by silence, distance, and the pressures of growing up.

results.title: Distance
results.overview: Ambika drives her late best friend’s 13-year-old son, Dhruv, back to boarding school after his father’s sudden death. The ride is strained by Dhruv’s unexplained animosity, which worsens when Ambika’s careless driving breaks his prized windmill science project. The journey culminates when Dhruv confronts her with a painful shared secret.

results.title: Damned
results.overview: A social-media influencer goes in search of an old, forgotten folk singer Naseem Bano, whose claim to fame was an off-hand compliment from Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan in 1988. He wants her to sing for his Instagram feed but she has forgotten herself. Late at night, when the whole hospital sleeps, she has a flash of memory.

results.title: Shores
results.overview: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

results.title: A River Colored Red
results.overview: In a mining-scarred Adivasi village under the shadow of the state–Naxal conflict, a 12-year-old boy’s encounter with a Tiger Spirit in the form of his long-dead uncle leads him to his family’s missing buffalo while uncovering buried memories of loss and violence. A Mundari language film.

results.title: Omega
results.overview: After surviving a catastrophic tsunami, Raven is exiled to a remote prison island inhabited by colossal creatures known as Omegas. But when a new terror emerges, she must stop history from repeating itself - even if it costs her freedom.

results.title: Halgi
results.overview: In a quiet Maharashtrian village, Janardan, a halgi player, inherits a family tradition he no longer believes in. For generations, his family has lived off the rhythm of the drum, but for him every beat carries caste, shame and suffocation. As events push him away from the halgi, his silence grows louder, until destiny pulls him back.

results.title: Accounts of a Killing
results.overview: The film is a collection of testimonies about how people remember the death of a young man in the town of Khuldabad in the Deccan. Through these memories of a death, each different from the other, the film attempts to sketch a portrait of the town, its people and the contested times we live in.

results.title: Dreamboat
results.overview: When an underground musician’s unconventional romance with her beloved pillow is violently cut short by her mother, she spirals into a delirious odyssey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires, and grip on reality are tested by an enigmatic homeless poet. As she searches for love and connection in an increasingly alienating city, the abandoned pillow begins to develop a will of its own.

results.title: Stray Girls
results.overview: A story from a working-class neighborhood in New Delhi, about a girl’s rebellion and it taking an unexpected magical turn.

results.title: Remote
results.overview: A lonely woman in a trailer watches live window views through webcams when she witnesses a murder. Armed with her tech expertise, she races to unmask the killer while staying alive.

results.title: Log 15
results.overview: Driven to save her mother from Alzheimer's, a desperate woman documents her radical experiments to unlock the human mind, only to discover the footage she is recording is actively rewriting her own reality.
